# glinet_network_interface (Resource)

Manage an OpenWrt network interface, including static addresses, VLANs, and DHCP clients. Keep a direct wired management path when changing an interface.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_network_interface.nas
  id = "vlan11"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_network_interface" "nas" {
  name         = "vlan11"
  device       = "br-vlan11"
  protocol     = "static"
  address      = "192.168.11.1/24"
  vlan_id      = 11
  display_name = "NAS"
  enabled      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) UCI interface name, such as `lan`, `guest`, or `vlan11`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `address` (String) IPv4 CIDR address, such as `192.168.8.1/24`.
- `defaultroute` (Boolean) Install the peer-advertised default route.
- `delegate` (Boolean) Delegate IPv6 prefix handling.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `device` (String) Underlying device or bridge, such as `br-lan`.
- `display_name` (String) GL.iNet display name.
- `dns` (Set of String) DNS servers for this interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `force_link` (Boolean) Bring up the interface even without a carrier.
- `gateway` (String) Optional IPv4 gateway.
- `hostname` (String) Optional DHCP hostname.
- `ip6assign` (Number) IPv6 prefix assignment length; zero leaves it unset.
- `ip6hint` (String) IPv6 prefix assignment hint.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 on this interface.
- `macaddr` (String) Optional MAC address override.
- `metric` (Number) Interface route metric; zero leaves it unset.
- `mtu` (Number) Interface MTU; zero leaves it unset.
- `password_version` (Number) Client-managed password generation. Increase it when rotating `password_wo`.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only PPPoE password. It is not stored in plan or state.
- `peerdns` (Boolean) Use peer-advertised DNS servers.
- `protocol` (String) UCI `proto`: `static`, `dhcp`, `pppoe`, or `none`.
- `username` (String) PPPoE username.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN ID for an interface. Zero means unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
